item.title: Banks notify customers of 7.5% VAT on transfers, USSD transactions from January 19
item.description: Several Nigerian banks, including Moniepoint, have notified their customers of the introduction of a 7.5 per cent Value Added Tax (VAT) on bank transfers and Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD) transactions, following a directive from the Nigeria Revenue Service (NRS). item.title: Nigeria misses OPEC quota for fifth month as crude output dips in December
item.description: Nigeria’s crude oil production declined marginally to 1.422 million barrels per day (bpd) in December 2025, down from 1.436 million bpd recorded in November, according to the latest Monthly Oil Market Report (MOMR) released by the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC). item.description: An Abuja High Court on Thursday brought to an end the criminal case instituted by the Federal Government against Senator Natasha Akpoti-Uduaghan, representing Kogi Central Senatorial District, striking out all charges in a decision that closes a protracted and politically charged legal battle. item.title: A British war Journalist’s account of how January 15 changed Nigeria
item.description: Frederick Forsyth’s account of the Nigerian Civil War, mainly from the Biafran lens, is perhaps one of the most riveting you would find. item.description: An Edo-based medical doctor, Dr. Ibrahim Tahir, has regained his freedom after his family paid a ransom of N50 million to his abductors.
